_comment: Central registry for multi-year support. Single source of truth shared by the scraper (scrape_hacktown.py) and the web app (index.html). Add a new year by adding an entry under 'years' and, when its data/API are ready, setting 'enabled': true. Set 'activeYear' to the year the app should show by default.

2026._todo: Event dates are set. The 'api' block still needs the real 2026 endpoint/params before the scraper can fetch data (python scrape_hacktown.py --year 2026). Until scraped, events/2026/ holds empty placeholder files so the app shows an empty 2026 cleanly. Venue mappings live in config/2026/locations_config.json (seeded from 2025).
